common_matching_requirements: instrument_class=exact stock futures contract, not underlying equity or continuous future
underlying and provider contract identifier crosswalk verified without symbol-only matching
expiry; option_type and strike explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE when documented, never missing-as-equal
trading_date=2026-09-10 and documented final daily session/cutoff/timezone/revision
quantity units and contract multiplier; price currency and scale
adjustment convention unadjusted exact contract; no split-adjusted equity or stitched series
common_field_semantics: Require field-by-field effective-date definitions of open/high/low/close eligible trade universe, window, exchange coverage and fallback; quantity trade-status inclusion and units; settlement separate from close. Unknown comparability is INDETERMINATE, not agreement/disagreement.

candidates.known_capabilities: Retained R10M evidence describes historical OHLCV and limited continuous daily futures. Existing application scope is current-only and excludes historical endpoints; current quote health is not target-date evidence.
candidates.field_semantics: Exact close basis, quantity inclusion, settlement availability and target-date applicability UNVERIFIED.
candidates.independence: NOT_ESTABLISHED; exchange feed versus independent candle aggregation lineage must be documented.
candidates.permission_retention: Current-session memory-only credential rules do not authorize historical response retention. Account/API entitlement and provider retention/minimal-paraphrase permission require explicit review.
candidates.credentials: Account/API application needed per retained evidence; do not inspect existing secrets or login. Any later credentials memory-only, separately scoped.

candidates.known_capabilities: No retained project evidence establishes the two exact NSE stock-futures contracts on the target date. Underlying equity history or a continuous futures symbol would not be comparable.
candidates.field_semantics: OHLC adjustment/close calculation, quantity units and settlement support UNVERIFIED.
candidates.independence: NOT_ESTABLISHED; do not assume a second website implies an independent feed.
candidates.permission_retention: Licensing, personal-use entitlement, automation and retention/reuse permission UNVERIFIED; no blanket personal-use inference.
candidates.credentials: Requirement UNVERIFIED; none accessed or presumed available.

candidates.known_capabilities: No retained authorized exact-contract historical snapshot, export interface or fixed endpoint established.
candidates.field_semantics: Individual contract versus stitched series, adjustment, settlement and quantity basis UNVERIFIED.
candidates.independence: NOT_ESTABLISHED; redistribution and calculation lineage unknown.
candidates.permission_retention: Access, automation, export, retention and sanitized reuse permission UNVERIFIED. No access-control bypass proposed.
candidates.credentials: Requirement UNVERIFIED; no account/subscription authorization assumed.

candidates.known_capabilities: No retained authorized target-date exact-contract export or fixed endpoint established.
candidates.field_semantics: Historical session/contract expiry/close and settlement basis, quantity units and adjustments UNVERIFIED.
candidates.permission_retention: Access/export/automation and retention/reuse permission UNVERIFIED; public display alone is not permission.

candidates.known_capabilities: Conditional offline option only: an already legally retained, provider-attributed two-target export could avoid agent network access, but existence and content are not established.
candidates.field_semantics: All identities and field definitions must be supplied, including effective date, adjustment convention and settlement separation.
candidates.independence: NOT_ESTABLISHED pending collection and redistribution lineage.
candidates.permission_retention: Owner must identify publisher and provide retention/minimal-paraphrase permission through 2026-12-31; owner approval is not publisher evidence.
candidates.credentials: None for a later separately approved local-file review; any prior provider access is outside this proposal.

agreement_limit: Numerical agreement could corroborate reported values under compatible definitions, but cannot establish original NSE semantics or date-wide trade coverage. Disagreement identifies a reconciliation need, not which provider is correct. Duplicate NSE-feed reports are dependent evidence.
